name: storyscope-writing
description: Write prose that does not carry the narrative fingerprints of AI text, based on the StoryScope study (arXiv 2604.03136).

plugins.name: storyscope-writing
plugins.description: Drafts and audits any writing (emails, docs, READMEs, posts, fiction) against the 30 core and 26 Claude-specific narrative tells measured in StoryScope, with a separate mode for work and technical writing.
